_doc: c02: level offsets in dB for accompanying lines that sit under a melody at the same printed dynamic: [qn_start, qn_end, dB]. score_to_parts.py writes them into vol_db (track volume envelope, 0.5 qn ramps); timbre (CC11) is unchanged. c04: Vc countermelody cuts eased (B #3), Cb cuts with the EQ (B #2), Vln II bars 63-66 (B #4, C #5), Vla and Harp under the flute solo and the harp under the bar 53-56 violins (B #5), Vc at the bar 61 climax (B #1). c04 after the first render: Vln II bar 64 split [216,218,-8]/[218,220,-2] (beats 3-4 measured 9-13 dB under Vla/Vc), Vc [238,250,-3] (was 2 dB under Vln I), Flute 1 [262,270,-2] (3 dB over Vln I in bar 80). c05: first crescendo bars 57-60 (B #1: BCl, Vla, Cb, Hn1, Timp down, Vln I +2), second build-up (B #2: Cl1 -4, Vln I +2), bars 28-30 violas (B #3), final chord violas +4/+7 (B #4), timp bar 52 (B #5), Hn3/Hn4 muted close -4 (B #6). c06: a row may carry a fourth value end_ramp (qn): the cut opens linearly over the last end_ramp qn and is 0 at its end (C #1: Vc, BCl, Vla, Cb, Hn1 into the bar 61 ff). Cb soft cuts eased and the pizz. span +5 (B #1); Hn3 under the bar 79-81 tune, Hn1 bars 54-56 (B #5); Vln II/Vla under the bar 46-47 oboe (B #6); Tbn2/BTbn/Tuba +2 at the bar 61 climax (C #4); Cl1 [250,258] -4 -> -1 (B #2, the p soft trim does the rest). c07: Vc [250,274,-5] split into [250,262,-5]/[262,274,-1] and Cb [262,276,-2] removed (B #2, bass and tenor lines under the reeds at bars 79-81); Hn3 [261.5,271] -4 -> -1 (B #1, with the F4 pitch trim); Flute 2 [204,212,-3] (B #3); Cb and Bn2 [146,151,-3] under the bar 47 oboe (B #6). c08: Vc [238,250] -3 -> 0 (B #2), [250,262] -5 -> -3 (C #6), Vc [292,304,-4], Vln I [292,304,-3], Vla [289,304,-2] (C #4, coda); Vla [42,48,-3], [140,146,-4] under the oboe (B #6); Vln I [48,65,-3] for the solo with SOLO_BOOST off (C #5 interim). c09: Cb [274,286,2] (4 measured Cb 1-2 dB over Vc in bars 83-84 with the c09 Cb EQ) replaces the c08 pitch-trim step at qn 274 (B #2); Vln I [204,208,-1.5] and Vln II [204,212,2] at the bar 61 octave theme (B #4). Spans that meet now crossfade (score_to_parts.py ROLE_CHAIN, A #2). c10: Violins I [48,65,-3] removed (the solo is its own track, A #1); Oboe 1 [139,151,2.5] (C #1, dolce espr. solo level with the Vc); Clarinet 1 [280,292,3] and Clarinet 2 [286,292,-2] (B #5, C #1, the coda dolce line under Cl2/Vln II); Timpani [277,280,10] (B #4, the pp melodic figure 6-11 dB under the ppp pedal). A span starting at a printed sf of its track starts after the attack (score_to_parts.py sf_shift, C #4b). c11: bar 61-62 winds evened (B #1: Fl1 [204,208,-4]/[208,212,1.5], Ob1 [204,208,-3]/[208,212,-1], Ob2 [204,210.1,8], Fl2 -3 -> +1, Cl2 [204,208,-2.5]); bass weight moved from the bass clarinet to the low brass (B #2: BCl [204,208.5,-4], Tuba 2 -> 5, BTbn 2 -> 4, Cbn [204,212,3]); Timpani [168,172,-4] -> [168,171.5,-4] (B #5, the p stroke at 172 starts at full level); Tbn1 [212.4,213.6,3] over the strings [212.6,213.6,-2] (B #6; the strings ramp in from 212.1, after the sf attack). c12: "_all" rows apply to every track: [204,212,-1] takes 1 dB back at bars 61-62 (C #1). Vln I [0,9.2,-5] and [292,304,-3] -> -6 (B #2, the ppp/pp Vln I C5 over the chord); Vln I [170.4,171.75,-4,0.15] / Vln II [170.4,171.7,-2.5,0.15] (A #4, the pickup into bar 53 over its downbeat; end_ramp so the cut is gone before the Leg Port target's moved onset); bar 79-80 lift (C #1, B #3): Vln I/Vln II/Vla/Cb [262,268,2.5], Vc [262,268,2] (adds to [262,274,-1]), Fl1 [262,270,-2] removed, Ob1 [262,268,6]/[268,271,4], Cl2 +4, Bn2 +4, BCl +2, Cbn +2; Horns 2-4 [204,212,2], Hn2/Hn4 [262,268,2] (C #5, brass colour at the climaxes); Hn3 [286,298] -4 -> +1, Hn4 -4 -> -1 (B #4, muted horns in the coda chord); Cor anglais [98.5,102,-3] (B #5, under the bar 34 bass clarinet solo). Horns 3-4 [0,17,-2] (C #2 alternative: the pp horn chord of bars 3-6 was the loudest part of the introduction, 2-4 dB over the clarinets and strings). c15: Double basses [108,137.5,5] -> 2 (B #2, the pizz. under the flute/CA solos peaked 6-15 dB over the flute); Violoncellos [78,90,-6] split into [78,87,-6]/[87,90,-2] and Double basses [87,90,-2] (B #4, the bar 30 pp cadence had the celli 5-9 dB under every voice); Violoncellos [262,265,2,0.25] (B #5, the bar 79 moving line 3-5 dB under the held violas). c16: B #1 Ob1 [271,274,-4]; B #3 Hn1 [262,265.5,3], Bn1 [262,265.5,2], Vla/Vln II [262.5,265,-2.5,0.25]; B #4 Vln I [244,262,2] -> [250,262,2] and Vln I/II/Vc [237.5,250,-2.5,0.5]; A #2 Vln II [114,116,3]; C #1 low octave at the ff tutti [200,214,dB,1] and [258,269,dB,1] (Cb +3, Cbn +3, Bn2 +3 (C's +4 taken down by 1, its own rule, because the simulated mp3 LRA was 16.1), Tuba +3, BTbn +3, BCl +2, Timp +2, Vc +1, Vln I -1, Vln II -0.5; C proposed 258-272, ended at 269 so the bar 81 decrescendo is not lifted). c18: Horn 1 [262,268,4,0.5] moved to "Horns 1-2 a2" (A #4); "Violins II div"/"Violas div" copy their sections' roles in the div windows, Violas div [276.5,304,-5] (ppp Eb4 7.6 dB over the main C4); _all [204,212,-1.4] gets end_ramp 3.5 and strings [211.75,213,1.5,0.5] (C #3, bar 62 sag and the sf); _all [9,17,2], [220,226,2], [274,280,2] (C #5, pp lifts). c19 (critic B #1-#6): BCl [93.5,99,-6,2.5] + CA [93,98.5,2] (BCl mf crest over the CA's dolce entry); Horn 1 crest row 1.5 -> -1.0 (B #2 asked -3; -2.5 keeps the crest about 1.5 dB over the bar 8 swell, -33.1 K); CA [127.5,133.5,-3.5,2.5]; BCl [105,110.5,-4] + Fl1 [108,112,2] (theme B entry); a2 horns [269,278,-5] (p bars 81-82); Violas [204,212,2.5]; Horn 3 [86,90,-3]. c20: Violas/Violas div [80,90,-3] -> [66,80,3]/[80,87,3]/[87,90,-3] and Violas [108,124,-4] -> -1.5 (B #1: the theme A inner voice 6-9 dB under the violins at the same p<mf>); bar 60 woodwind chord righted: BCl/Bn1 [200,204,-4], Bn2 -3, Cl2 -2, Fl1/Ob1 +2 (B #2); Harp [180,188,-3] under the bar 55-56 mp violins (B #3); _all [250,258.5,-3,5.5] and [259,262,1.5,0.5] (C #1: the bars 75-78 crescendo started loud and arrived soft). c20 after the render (gain-only, applied to the stems): Violas/Violas div [80,87,3] -> 0.5 (bars 28-29 came out 0.5-1.6 dB under Vln I, target 3.5-5); Harp [180,188,-3] -> -1 and [172,180,2] (the c20 side shelf and width took 2.8 dB off the harp at 172-180 and 2.9 more at 180-188). c22: Vc [188,204,-3,4] split into [188,190,-1.5] + [190.5,204,-3,4] (C #2b, the cut comes in over two beats); Harp [238,262,4] (B #4, bars 71-78 p/pp chords 17-25 dB A under the mix); _all morendo [298.5,299.5,-1] [299.5,300.5,-2] [300.5,303.5,-3] (C #5, bar 91 fell only 2.4-3.7 dB). c23: the ten [258,269,dB,1] low-octave rows start at 261.5 (B #2: in the f bar 78 Bn2 was level with Vln I; the weight belongs to the ff of bar 79); Violoncellos [73.5,78,-2] and [245.5,250,-2] (B #3, the p cantabile came level with the mp violins on their low notes); Clarinet 1 [287.4,289,2.5] (B #4, the coda D flat 5 sagged 6 dB to the horn's level). c24: B #1 Horn 1 [179.25,180.75,-6.5] (the bar 55 countermelody's mp arrival stood 2-6 dB over the two violin sections playing the theme). C #1 Horn 1 [20.5,23.5,-2.5,1] (the bar 8 unmarked swell, so the bar 12 printed crest stands 3.5 dB over it). C #2 Oboe 1 [140,143,-2,0.5] and [148,151,3.5,2], Violoncellos [148,151,3,2] (the bar 47 mf arrival was under bar 45). B #2 + C #4 coda: Clarinet 1 [284.25,285.75,3] (offsets the taper into the 286 breath; B's 4 reduced by the C #4 lift) and [283,292,1.5,1]; [283,291.5,-2,0.5] on Horn 3, Horn 4, Violas, Violas div, Violoncellos, Double basses (the clarinet solo sat under its accompaniment). c25: Clarinet 1 coda lifts held to 297 and released over 2 qn across the bar 90 decrescendo (A #1; they ended at 292 on the resolution C5); Clarinet 2 [286,295,-2] (A #1); Timpani ppp rolls +4/+3/+4 at 3-8.5, 226-237.5, 292-304 (B #2: 14-23 dB under the orchestra, masked).
